Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, teeno mein 4 hisse, par 1/9 ka hissa sabse chhota aur 1/5 ka sabse bada; isliye 4/9, phir 4/7, phir 4/5. Anjali aur Gopi ke paas ek jaisi ribbon ki patti hai. Anjali apni patti ko 12 barabar hisson mein kaatkar 5 leti hai, aur Gopi apni patti 6 mein kaatkar 5 leta hai. Kiske paas lamba hissa hai, Anjali ke ya Gopi ke?
director.card: Anjali aur Gopi ke paas ek jaisi ribbon ki patti hai. Anjali apni patti ko 12 barabar hisson mein kaatkar 5 leti hai, aur Gopi apni patti 6 mein kaatkar 5 leta hai. Kiske paas lamba hissa hai, Anjali ke ya Gopi ke?

director.text: Gopi, 5/6

Haan, bilkul theek: dono ke paanch-paanch hisse, par Gopi ka har hissa Anjali ke hisse ka do guna, toh Gopi ke paanch zyada lambe. Do pizza hain, bilkul ek jaise. Ek ke 7 barabar hisson mein se 6 bache, doosre ke 9 mein se 8. Har pizza se bas ek hissa gayab hai. Poore pizza ke zyada paas kaun hai, 6/7 ya 8/9?
director.card: Do pizza hain, bilkul ek jaise. Ek ke 7 barabar hisson mein se 6 bache, doosre ke 9 mein se 8. Har pizza se bas ek hissa gayab hai. Poore pizza ke zyada paas kaun hai, 6/7 ya 8/9?

director.text: 8/9 wala

Sahi jawab, kyunki 8/9 mein bas 1/9 ki kami hai, 6/7 mein 1/7 ki, aur 1/9 ki kami chhoti hai. Do ek jaisi patti hain: ek ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 7 liye, doosri ke 12 mein se 7. Kaunsa chhota hai, 7/10 ya 7/12?
pehle wale step se pata chala

Iska jawab hai 7/12, kyunki dono se 7 hisse liye, par 12 hisson wali patti ka har hissa chhota hai, isliye 7/12 chhota hai. Aaj ka paath yeh tha ki ek hi poore ko jitne zyada barabar hisson mein kaatein, har hissa utna chhota hota hai. Neeche ka number same ho toh upar ka number faisla karta hai, aur upar ka number same ho toh hisse ka size faisla karta hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge!
